name: Kedra Checkout Rules & Upsells
summary: Shopify app that hides, renames or reorders payment and shipping methods, validates the checkout and adds post-purchase upsells through no-code rules, with checkout analytics.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want to hide, rename or reorder payment and shipping methods, validate the checkout and add post-purchase upsells with rules instead of a developer, for a few dollars a month
skip_if: you need to add visual blocks or custom fields to the checkout page itself, which the app cannot do; or many of your orders are created as draft orders in the admin, where the rules do not apply
honest_knock: The free plan runs a single rule with a single condition, and Starter only three, and the listing and Kedra's own documentation disagree on whether that limit is per rule type or in total. The app cannot add anything visual to the checkout page, and rules skip draft orders made in the Shopify admin. We found no published refund or cancellation policy.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · billed monthly through the Shopify invoice in USD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-15 on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/kedra-checkout-rules-1, prices in USD) Four plans, billed through your Shopify invoice. Free allows 1 active rule in total, of any type, with 1 condition per rule and 7 days of checkout analytics. Starter is $6.99 a month, or $58.70 a year, which the listing calls a 30% saving: 3 active rules in total, 3 conditions per rule and full checkout analytics. Starter Plus is $8.99 a month or $75.50 a year and adds post-purchase upsell offers. Unlimited is $12.99 a month or $109.10 a year, with unlimited checkout validation, payment and shipping, and shipping discount rules, and no limit on conditions per rule. Paid plans list a 7-day free trial. One inconsistency to know about: the listing counts the rule limit in total across all types, while Kedra's own pricing documentation describes it per rule type. The documentation also says stores that installed before 3 August 2026 keep unlimited rules.

compare_with.name: Smarty Discounts
compare_with.why: Smarty Discounts is in our dossiers too and also works with rules in the Shopify checkout, but on the price side: tiered, capped and buy-X-get-Y discounts, with Lite at $9.99 a month or $99.99 a year when we read it on 11 October 2026. Kedra controls which payment and shipping options a shopper sees and whether the checkout goes through, from $6.99 a month. If your problem is the discount logic, look at Smarty Discounts; if it is the checkout options themselves, Kedra.
